name: com.three-ws.forge-bridge
description: Generate textured 3D models from a text prompt or reference photos with the free three.ws Forge pipeline, straight into the Unity Editor. Imports the result with glTFast, Unity's own glTF importer. No mock server: every call goes to the live public API documented in specs/ENGINE_BRIDGE.md.

samples.description: A runnable example: a MonoBehaviour that performs a real text-to-3D generation and drops the imported mesh in front of the camera at runtime when Space is pressed.
